tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya pa'i phyag len gtor ma drug cu bzhi'i gtong tshul bzhugs/ /sintartha'o// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma sa skya pa rgyun du phyag len mdzad pa nyin mo'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ dbyig gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bar chad bsal ba dang mthun pa bsgrub pa ste/ ji skad du sgra bsgyur las/ lo re'i de bzhin zla re 'am/ /de bzhin nyi ma so so la/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi gtong / /dbyig gu drug cu rtsa bzhir shes/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhag re la ma grub na/ zla ba re la/ de la ma grub na lo re la cis kyang gtong / de'i cho ga ni/ a ka ros ya tha sangs rgyas nas bzung ste ma tha rigs drug thams cad la gtong ba yin te/ /de'ang bzhi tshan bcu drug du gtong ngo / de nas dges pa'i rdo rje la/ /de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ de nas 'byung po spyi la/ de nas phyogs skyong bcu la'o/ /de gnyis dpung bzang gi lugs ltar bya'o/ /mtshan mo gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /dang po gsum bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba la/ de nas gsum rje btsun ma sgrol ma la/ de nas gsum pa gcig kha 'bar ma'i gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de nas gcig a ka ros rang gi chos skyong la/ de nas gcig a ka ros chos skyong spyi la/ de nas gsum lha'i drang srong la/ 'di man chad gsum tshan lnga kha 'bar ba/ de nas gsum lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la/ de nas dgu yid dwags blo de nas gsum gyi gcig yid dwags/ bur du lhags 'di gsum a ka ros nas re ba la/ gcig dbang chung ba rnams la/ gcig gzhi bdag rnams la sbyin no/ /de nas chu sbyin btang la mdo 'don/ de nas spyi gtor rnams la btang la yang mdo 'don/ de nas nang nub kyi bya ba yan lag bdun pa la sogs pa byas la/ de nas thun gtor gtang la thun gtor gtang nas nub kyi bya ba byas kyang 'gal ba med gsung /

mngon rtogs bsgom/ gtor ma la mar me btsugs la sa gtsang sar bskyal/ de nas snying po ci rigs pa bzlas la/ bsam gtan yod na bya med na gnyid log ྀatsha/ 'di slob dpon jo sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis ye shes seṅge'i don du bris pa'o/ /'di ni sgo rum gyi phyag dpe rnying ma shog bris la bris pa gcig la bris pa yin cing / ji lta ba bzhin yin no// ༈ //mtshan brjod 'don thabs bzhugs/ swasti/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod la 'don thabs mang po yod kyang / yongs su grags pa gsum ste/ sngags ltar 'don pa/ mtshan che ba'i yon tan la dmigs te 'don pa/ mtshan de nyid la dmigs te 'don pa yin gsung ngo / /gsum ka mdor bsdus te 'don pa'i gdam ngag la/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gcig yod pa la/ thun mong du mdun bskyed ni/ gnas dben par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ de nas rang gi mdun du/ padma'i sdong po chen po gcig bsgom/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ yi ge mam̐ dmar ser gcig bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus/ mam̐ la thim nas mam̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gyi mdog can lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gnyis kyi shes rab kyi ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyi utpa la thugs kar 'dzin pa'i me tog snyan gyi thad kar rgyas pa'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i po ti can dang / gzhu'o/ /zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ dar gyi con pan dang / rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ gzhon nu lo brgyad dam/ bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam la/ thog mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ de'i 'og tu rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi bskor ba/

lha dang / klu dang / rigs ldan dang / chos skyong dang / phyogs skyong 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams kyi skor bar bsgom te/ rang gi sems spros bral la/ ngag brag cha lta bus/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas/ a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ zhes bya ba'i bar gleng gzhi yin/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das man chad/ bstod pa la dmigs la 'don/ phan yon dang / gcig spel nas ston pas zhal myur du mthong zhing / sku rdzogs par mthong gsung / rjes la dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad dang / thun mong du byas te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo'o/ /rgya gar du paṇḍi ta gcig gis mtshan brjod ston pas sku lte ba yan chad mthong skad/ paṇḍi tas sku rdzogs par mi mthong ba ci yin zhus pas/ phan yon ma ston pas lan pa yin gsung / chos rje lo tsā ba'i man ngag yin/ dmar chos rgyal gyis/ sa skya paṇḍi ta la zhus nas mdzad/ sa skya pa'i phyag len gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtong tshul dang mtshan brjod 'don thabs kyis yi ge rnying ma 'di gnyis sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi phyogs gcig tu sdeb pa'o// ༈ //'jam dbyangs ḍombhi ba/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ 'phags pa klu sgrub rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du sa chen rtse mo sa paṇa 'phags pa rnams la zhal dngos su bstan nas gdams pa zab mo gnang ba'i tshogs rnams dang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las rje btsun grags pa lung bstan tshul rnams phyogs gcig tubasdeb pa'i yi ge dad pa skyed byed bzhugs so/ /'jam dbyangs kyis sa chen la/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /zhes gsungs/ ḍom bhi was rtse mo la/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis/ /lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba ltar/ /rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis/ /nyon mongs ye shes lam du 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rje btsun lung bstan pa ni/ de bzhin 'jig rten sbyin gnas 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed/ /sngags dang rgyud ma mngon brtson pas/ /grags pa 'dzin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ sgrol mas sa paṇa la/ gang byung gis chog na ci byas bde/ /sems bzhag sar sdod na phyin yang chog /blo chos su song na shi yang bla/ /sems skye med du rtogs na 'chi ba med/ /ces gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis 'phags pa la/ rtag tu 'chi ba bsam par byas/ /de yis tshe 'di'i zhen pa bzlog /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par bya/ /srid par smon pa'i yid bral 'gyur/ /'gro la byams brtse bsgom par bya/ /gcig tu bdag don gnyer ba bzlog /chos rnams stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa spong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs/ ḍombhi ba/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ 'phags pa klu sgrub rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du sa chen/ rtse mo/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rnams la zhal dngos su bstan nas gdam pa zab mo gnang ba'i tshigs rnams dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las rje btsun grags pa lung bstan tshul rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i yi ge dad pa skyed byed ces pa 'di yang sa skya'i dpe khang gi bla ma gong ma'i phyag dpe mang po bzhugs pa'i glegs bam rnying pa zhig gi khrod na 'dug pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i dad pa'i dbang gi rnyed pa phyogs cig tu bsdebs pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sa skya pa'i phyag len gtor ma drug cu bzhi'i gtong tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
